text: OT cybersecurity shall be designed per IEC 62443 with the target security level SL-T 2 for every zone, as required by ER-12.07: zones and conduits per IEC 62443-3-2, security requirements of the systems per IEC 62443-3-3 (SL-C at or above SL-T), secure product development and component requirements of IEC 62443-4-1 and 4-2 demonstrated by the suppliers, and security acceptance test.
